THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics and Critical Review

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to calculate and interpret measures of treatment impact for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Distinguish probability from odds and convert between them.
  2. Calculate an odds ratio and explain when it approximates the relative risk.
  3. Calculate relative risk, absolute risk reduction and relative risk reduction from trial data.
  4. Explain why relative measures can make benefit look larger than absolute measures.
  5. Calculate the number needed to treat as 1/ARR and the number needed to harm, rounding up to whole patients.
  6. Answer the chapter's 87 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
